baseline.method: Independently reproduced pyGPA adaptive wavefront fit

threshold_provenance: Numerical stationarity budget 1e-3; existing ten-step estimate has residual 2.294369237466319e-4; independently evaluated converged control has 9.187447443762273e-10, zero has 1 and reversed displacement has 1.999995723415685. This v2 contract replaces finite-implementation array agreement with an explicitly defined derived-observation inverse; no displacement truth is claimed.
metric_definition: For each component in pixels compute ||D^T W(Du-g)||_2 / ||D^T Wg||_2; take component maximum. Gauge is maximum absolute component mean in nm.
